name: Feros Ferio Winery
bio: Feros Ferio Winery has a small tasting room on East Ojai Avenue in Ojai, pouring blended wines made in Santa Ynez. It has live music every Saturday and Sunday from 4 to 6pm.
bio_source: Written by TOPA from ferosferiowine.com and @ferosferiowinery.
source: public web search, the venue's website and public Instagram, and US Census address lookup, 2026-10-29
